runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved and the target never dereferences a vtable
all seven ports are dependency-only, so the append, truncate, finalise and destroy effects are unverified in this package
the Thumbnails literal at 0x013fa030 is undecoded beyond its unit sequence
the separator mask 0x0ff0f is read as a wide compare against the last buffer unit and its runtime meaning is unverified
decompilation_defects_corrected: the eleven in the staging model is a frozen literal; the binary derives the count from the literal's terminator through the inlined wcslen idiom at 0x005f936a, so the model computes the length and the metadata records the derivation rather than the frozen value
the decompilation renders the terminator scan as a library strlen; the assembly at 0x005f93ed is an inline add 2 / cmp word / jne loop followed by SUB EAX,0x13fa034 / SAR EAX,1
the 0x0ff0f compare is a sixteen bit unit compare, not a thirty-two bit one, so the model widens only the low unit
